# truenas_cloud_backup (Data Source)

Fetches a TrueNAS cloud backup task by description.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Task description to look up.

### Read-Only

- `absolute_paths` (Boolean) Whether absolute paths are preserved in each backup.
- `attributes` (String) JSON document of provider-specific attributes.
- `cache_path` (String) Local path used to cache restic metadata, if configured.
- `credentials` (Number) ID of the cloud sync credentials used.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the task is enabled.
- `exclude` (List of String) Paths passed to `restic backup --exclude`.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the cloud backup task.
- `include` (List of String) Paths passed to `restic backup --include`.
- `keep_last` (Number) How many of the most recent backup snapshots to keep.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for the restic repository. See the resource's schema documentation for read-back caveats.
- `path` (String) The local path backed up.
- `post_script` (String) Bash script run immediately after every successful backup.
- `pre_script` (String) Bash script run immediately before every backup.
- `rate_limit` (Number) Maximum upload/download rate in KiB/s, if configured.
- `schedule` (Attributes) Cron schedule dictating when the task should run. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule))
- `snapshot` (Boolean) Whether a temporary dataset snapshot is taken before every backup.
- `transfer_setting` (String) Transfer performance profile.

<a id="nestedatt--schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule`

Read-Only:

- `dom` (String)
- `dow` (String)
- `hour` (String)
- `minute` (String)
- `month` (String)
